capabilities: Sends one Markdown note to Rune & Quill through the system share sheet
Omits YAML properties and renders wiki links and embeds as text
Suggests a default destination folder from plugin settings
Keeps linked notes and vault attachments inside Obsidian
extras: Rune & Quill requires separate TestFlight access; import file limited to 2 MiB; plugin makes no network requests and writes nothing to the vault.
problem: Obsidian on iPhone and iPad has no built-in way to hand a note to Rune & Quill for PDF reading and annotation.

relations.evidence: Send a Markdown note from Obsidian to Rune & Quill on iPhone or iPad.

summary: iOS share-sheet integration that sends a Markdown note to Rune & Quill as a PDF for reading and markup.
